children: BSE Ltd, Asia’s first stock exchange, has announced that the United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has approved the offer and sale of BSE BANKEX Index Futures in the United States, subject to applicable provisions of the US Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations. The approval follows the successful completion of the CFTC’s 45-day expedited review process, during which the BANKEX Contract was determined to meet the applicable requirements under the US Commodity Exchange Act (CEA).
RRP Defence partners Israel’s McTech for anti-drone technology

RRP Defence Ltd, a listed company of the RRP Group, has entered into a strategic joint venture with Israel-based McTech to introduce advanced Anti-Drone and Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS) technologies in India.

As drone technology continues to evolve, its use in modern warfare and security operations is growing rapidly. While drones create new possibilities, they also bring new challenges. The ability to detect, counter and neutralise potential drone threats has therefore become increasingly important for India’s defence and security forces.
McTech Israel brings valuable technological expertise and a wide range of advanced anti-drone solutions designed to address different operational requirements.
ACME Solar signs PPA for 220 MW solar-BESS project in Madhya Pradesh

ACME Greentech Sixteen Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of ACME Solar Holdings Limited, has executed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Rewa Ultra Mega Solar Limited (RUMSL) to set up a 220 MW Solar with Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project at Morena Solar Park in Madhya Pradesh.
The project size is 220 MW (Unit II) Solar with BESS, at a tariff of Rs. 2.764 per unit, with a scheduled commercial operation date (SCOD) of December 31, 2027.
Dixon Technologies to acquire Vimal’s assets for ₹49.75 crore

Dixon Technologies has entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Vimal wherein Dixon will acquire movable assets such as Moulds, Research & Development Lab equipment, Basket Assembly Korean machines, jigs and fixtures, etc. from Vimal for up to Rs 49.75 crore excluding applicable taxes and subject to satisfactory completion of conditions precedent as set out in the Agreement.
Lemon Tree Hotels signs Keys Lite property in Punjab
Lemon Tree Hotels Limited, one of India’s leading hospitality companies, today announced the signing of Keys Lite by Lemon Tree Hotels, Banga in Punjab.
The property will be operated under a franchise agreement, further strengthening the Group’s presence in the state and expanding its footprint across emerging commercial destinations.

With this signing, Lemon Tree Hotels’ portfolio in Punjab will comprise three operational hotels and 11 upcoming properties, reflecting its continued focus on building a presence across key business centres and developing markets.
SML Mahindra fixes rights issue price at ₹3,506 per share

The Board of Directors of SML Mahindra Ltd on November 6 had approved raising funds through the issuance of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company of the face value of Rs. 10 each by way of a rights issue for an amount not exceeding Rs. 1,450 Crore, subject to receipt of regulatory and statutory approvals.

Further, pursuant to the in-principle approval received from BSE Ltd and National Stock Exchange, the board has fixed a rights issue price of Rs 3,506 per share and an entitlement of 2 fully paid-up rights shares for every 7 shares held by eligible shareholders as on the Record Date, i.e., November 20.
PNG Jewellers to set up subsidiary for jewellery manufacturing

P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd has announced plans to incorporate a new subsidiary, marking a significant step toward strengthening its supply chain through backward integration and entering into the manufacturing of diamond and gold jewellery.

The initial investment is estimated at up to ₹10 crore and will primarily be used to acquire relevant business assets and inventory, funded through internal accruals. PNG Jewellers will hold a 76 per cent equity stake in the new entity.
ARSS Infrastructure bags ₹131.10-crore Northern Railway order
ARSS Infrastructure Projects Ltd has announced that it has received a work order of ₹131,10,40,131.85 from Northern Railway.

The order is for the design and construction of Important Bridge No. 75 (span 14 x 30.5m Composite Girder) for two tracks parallel to the existing rail bridge between Jaunpur and Zafrabad on the Northern Railway section.
XTGlobal gets RBI nod for €10,000 investment in Irish subsidiary

XTGlobal Infotech Ltd has received approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for an overseas equity investment of EUR 10,000 in its wholly owned subsidiary, XTG Infotech Europe Ltd, incorporated in Ireland on July 24, 2026.
The equity investment represents the Company’s initial capital contribution towards the share capital of its Irish subsidiary.
B-Right Realestate signs term sheet for Mumbai SRA redevelopment project
B-Right Realestate Limited has entered into a Term Sheet with Super Constructions Co. for the proposed redevelopment of the “Chandani Agar SRA” project located at Wadala (East), Mumbai.

The project is a Government Land SRA project. This project falls under the affordable housing category. The preliminary approval, i.e., the Letter of Intent (LOI), has already been issued by the approving authority (SRA).
